title: The Unsafe Room
lines: Jack had a small room at the top.
He kept his socks and blocks in it.
But he never set them back neatly.
Soon the room was a big mess.
Dad said, "This is unsafe. Fix it."
Jack was unhappy, but he was helpful.
He tried to get it all in one bin.
The bin was too small. It fell over.
Blocks went rolling under the bed.
Jack sat down. Then he had a plan.
Socks in the bin, blocks on the shelf.
He slowly restacked the shelf three times.
At last the room was neat and safe.
Dad said, "That was helpful. Thanks, Jack!"
Now Jack can find his socks fast.

questions.ask: What did Dad say about the room?
questions.listenFor: That it was unsafe and had to be fixed. Have them find the word unsafe.

questions.ask: What went wrong when Jack put it all in one bin?
questions.listenFor: The bin was too small, it fell over, and the blocks rolled under the bed.

questions.ask: Do you think Jack felt better at the end? Why do you think so?
questions.listenFor: Either answer. Listen for a reason from the story - the neat room, or what Dad said last.
